name: flowcall

explain.accuracy: Of the labelled calls the block answered, how many answers matched the label. The block is called again with each row's input, as it is now. A block this instance does not know, or one that is gone, is an error row, never run.

description: Any FlowCall block's call log: each labelled row's input through the block again, its answer judged against the row's label. Used when a dataset has no eval of its own kind.
